latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Editing With Music — Sync Video Cuts to Music".
- Automatically syncs video cuts to music; supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB.
- Provides simple cloud-based editing—processes in 30–60 seconds, returns 1080p MP4 results.
- Supports drag-and-drop uploads, aspect ratio changes, background music, and text overlays.
- Session and credits management handled via integrated API calls for a seamless workflow.
- Clear error handling and workflow tips included for a smooth user experience.
